name: ci-watch
description: Watches CI on pull requests the agent drafts or opens, in a live pane, the status line and a notification when it settles

pollSeconds.title: Poll interval (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often gh pr checks is asked while a PR's CI runs

onFinish.title: When CI settles
onFinish.description: notify: toast and desktop notification. tell-claude: also leave Claude a note with the result. fix-failures: also start a turn asking Claude to fix failing checks
